PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/>
PREFIX ref: <http://ref/>
SELECT ?s ?label ?prop ?o WHERE {
  ?s ref:label ?label.
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?label), "core_top") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?label), "core top"))
  ?s ?prop ?o.
}
LIMIT 200
